items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I asked Harry last time I saw him at a thing for Max Roach

ctx.x: Good, ‘cause I got a copy which is not so good, and I asked Harry last time I saw him at a thing for Max Roach to send me a copy, but the only copy I got is off of the television.

Now, you made two albums because the actual soundtrack was not MJQ, but it was a larger ensemble and I think it was the first time that John Lewis and all of you guys worked with Bill Evans, the piano player, in that particular setting.
